_comment: Tweet IDs that the timeline/search/conversation-chase steps don't surface. Each ID is fetched via /2/tweets?ids=… which bypasses the filtering applied to user-timeline and search queries. To add an ID: copy it from a tweet URL (the digits after /status/), append it to the list. The script handles deduplication against the main dataset automatically. Tweets added via this path appear in the table with a 'direct-id' badge.
